quote: Vinny is hands down the best barber in Fairfax. His precision and attention to detail on my fade and beard trim are unmatched, and the private suite inside Sola Salon feels relaxed and welcoming.
Super friendly personality and he genuinely listens to what you want before picking up the clippers. No rushing, clean transitions, and you walk out feeling confident every single time.
Booked the Straight Razor Shave before an event and it was next-level relaxing. The facial steamer, hot towels, and soothing skin care were top notch. Easy parking right behind the Sunoco too!

I didn’t know a barber shop could be life changing, but it was! Vinny cut my son’s hair and actually asked if it hurt when he combed out his thick curly black hair. He had a TV and gave my son control of picking what he wanted to watch and I chilled out in the full body massage chair. I cannot more highly recommend this shop!

Excellent hair cut and beard trim. Vinny really took his time to make sure I was in perfect shape. Clean modern space and friendly atmosphere paired with a great conversation. Will be a regular here after searching for a barber for the last few months.

Vinny is a great barber and provides a great individual experience with his setup at Ace of Hearts. Nice guy to chat with and get a clean, fresh cut. Electronic massage chair was definitely a nice perk. Highly recommend checking him out for your next haircut.
